proposal.summary: The report describes a power-related emergency-care outage at Demo Hospital B. Verify operating conditions and coordinate alternatives before moving resources.

actions.title: Verify Hospital B outage scope and backup power
steps: Contact the Hospital B emergency coordinator and technical team.
Confirm which service areas remain operational and whether approved backup power is available.
actions.rationale: The incident reports an unavailable service; extra equipment alone may not restore operation.
prerequisites: Confirm the report with the facility; the incident is still a draft.

actions.title: Resolve receiving-hospital information before relocation
steps: Request current service status, complete resource observations and occupancy from alternative hospitals.
Ask the coordinator to verify receiving capability and logistics before choosing a destination.
actions.rationale: Hospital A has an unknown estimate and Hospital C reports an unavailable service; neither is an established receiving option.
prerequisites: Verify current operating status, occupancy, compatibility and transport availability.

questions: What is Hospital B current occupancy and expected outage duration?
